title: euryloma aitonii
intro: Euryloma aitonii, commonly known as the Andaman Box Tree, is a plant species native to the Andaman Islands. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, inflammation, and digestive problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Euryloma aitonii include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce swelling and protect cells from damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
